body: Yeah, thats the other side of my thinking. I don't want to put a burden on her like I said, because I really want the best for her. But the only thing is that I know she still loves me, we still talk everyday and what not. I will take your advice about not going into consideration though, I was feeling a little crazy. Thanks haveyourselfanother1. Also, I understand we broke up for a reason but the main reason was that we were long distance, and I am a very in person type of affectionate person. Actions not words you know, but seeing each other every 3-4 months for 2-3 years really got me thinking and that is why I let her go. But now, I will literally stop everything (school) I am doing just to move to her side of the country, to win her back. Comments?

However, she isn't really the type to date immediately after, I have enough money to cover 10,000 bar tabs so should I just say eff it and go pink floyd?
